errors.invalidJson: The server returned an invalid response. This often happens when the API is restarting; wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.invalidJsonShort: The server did not return valid data. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.gatewayTimeout: The server did not respond in time (502/503 error). This often happens when the API is restarting. Wait 10–20 seconds and try again.
errors.dbMigration: A database update is missing (column not found). Contact us to apply the migration in Supabase.
errors.dbPermission: Could not save: permission denied. Sign out, sign in again, and retry.
errors.dbInvalidUuid: Invalid consultation ID. Open the consultation from history or create a new one.
errors.dbDuplicate: This record already exists. Reload the page and try again.
errors.dbConnection: Could not connect to the database. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.networkLocalProd: Could not connect to {{base}}. For local development use the backend at http://localhost:8000. Reload the page (Ctrl+Shift+R) or run in the console: localStorage.removeItem('backend_url'); location.reload();
errors.networkProd: Could not connect to the server ({{base}}). Check your connection or open https://api.guiaa.vet/docs in another tab. If the API responds, try incognito mode or clear your browser cache.
errors.requestTimeout: The request took too long. The server may be starting; wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.emptyResponse: The server returned no data. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.invalidResponseRetry: The server returned an invalid response. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.vetContext: useVet must be used within a VetProvider
